title: Grateful Dead Live at Augusta Civic Center on 1984-10-12
source: Remastered version of the original Oade source 8795 by Dave Usborne: Izotope RX Advanced Declick and Spectral Repair used manually to fix pops and digital artifacts. Editing done in Reaper V4.591/X64; Tracks cut and Flac files created in Audacity 2.0.6
